elements_selected.content: Prove compatibility between arithmetic evaluation and grounding: if a substitution satisfies all arithmetic constraints in a rule body, then the ground rule preserves the constraint truth values. This bridges grounding.rs and arith.rs.

Created lean/Spindle/Arith/GroundingCompat.lean (~330 lines, 0 sorry). Bridges Substitution→ValueEnv via toValueEnv with VarNameTable. 6 main theorems: applySubst_ground, constraints_deterministic, ground_preserves_constraints, groundWith_success (main), groundWith_isGround, groundWith_constraints_satisfied. Corollaries for covering substitutions and empty constraints.
